_comment: ADOPTER EXAMPLE (rc.38 · flow-plan Phase 4.3) — a STANDARD change riding a pre-approved pattern, mounted as docs/governance/changes/CHG-2026-0055/. Everything about the route is identical to a normal change: the same profiles, the same compiler, the same plan. What differs is WHEN the approval was given. A second-line human approved the `dependency-patch` pattern in profiles/regulated-bank.json — its matcher, its size ceiling, and the EXACT plan hash a change matching it compiles to — so this change's PA1/PA2 receipts were given once, on the pattern, and this change is enrolled in the pattern's post-hoc sample instead of collecting eight signatures again. Break any one of the pattern's conditions (expire it, widen the diff, touch a path outside the matcher, compile a different plan) and the pre-approval stops applying and this change takes the FULL route. Nothing here is a waiver.

sampling._comment: Enrolment is recorded ON THE CHANGE so the sampled population can be reconstructed from the tree. When `selected` is true this block must also carry reviewed_by (a second-line human) and reviewed_at, or the gate fails: a sample nobody reviews is a sample nobody took.

classification.rationale: Patch-level dependency bump inside the credit-origination service. No contract, schema or control-plane surface moves; the change qualifies for the dependency-patch pattern.
